# ostree / fuzz-repo

OSS-Fuzz's fuzz target `fuzz-repo` ([source](source/fuzz-repo.c), unmodified) over ostree (ostreedev/ostree at 1d5a312a).

Creates an archive-mode repo in a temp dir, sets config key [input] input=input, writes, reloads the config and reads min-free-space-bytes; all return values and errors ignored.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against ostree at commit 1d5a312a.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.

## Statements ([Statements.v](Statements.v))

**Some statements are blocked by the model.** On the inputs they cover, the binary checks file access permissions, uses directories, reads or sets descriptor flags, opens files with flags the model does not cover, opens files other than its input, reads /proc and calls stat on files, which this release's model does not decode, so the statements marked "blocked by the model" are false in this model for that reason alone. The program is not at fault.
